summary: PASS — No P0 (deceptive behavior) or P1 (recipe correctness) issues found. The adwaita-icon-theme 49.0 Conan recipe is a data-only icon theme package (no C/C++ compilation) that passes all critical audit checks. Key findings: (1) R34 — test_package is NOT a stub; it comprehensively verifies index.theme, icon directories (16x16/scalable/symbolic), cursor symlinks (≥10), license files (COPYING/COPYING_CCBYSA3/COPYING_LGPL), and .pc file content, plus includes self.run() calls for binary verification on target. (2) R39 — source URL https://github.com/GNOME/adwaita-icon-theme/archive/refs/tags/49.0.tar.gz is from the official GNOME GitHub organization (not a personal fork). (3) SHA256 0702ce73eb9316d48f074b183ba71d87e9f9f76a399020de70f3eea824db8b5e is a valid 64-char hex hash, not a placeholder. (4) Patch 0001-meson.build.patch is valid, correctly referenced in conandata.yml, and contains substantive logic (makes gtk-update-icon-cache optional via required:false + conditional add_install_script). (5) conanfile.py uses Conan 2.x API correctly (from conan import ConanFile, conan.tools.meson), method order is correct, package_info is appropriate for data-only package (empty libs/libdirs/includedirs + buildenv_info for ADWAITA_ICON_THEME_DIR only). (6) manifest.yaml status 'built' is consistent across manifest/notes/README. (7) No pre-compiled binaries, no #ifdef __OHOS__ stubs, no skipped tests. All previously identified P2/P3 issues (template placeholder in url field, os.environ usage in package_info, patch_type/description format, notes.md filename inconsistency, manifest guard status) have been resolved in the latest commit. Software-level manifest.yaml added for version index completeness.
